component.name: OpenZap
component.summary: Watch IPTV playlists with a programme guide

description.p: OpenZap plays IPTV channels from an M3U playlist, with an XMLTV programme guide. Playlists and guides can be local files or URLs.

ul.li: Channel list with search, groups, favorites and logos
What is on now and next, and the full guide of each channel
Audio track and subtitle switching, picture size, always on top
Downloaded playlists and guides are kept, so the app starts fast and works when a server is down

description.p: OpenZap does not come with any channels: you need a playlist.

screenshot.caption: A playlist with its programme guide, dark theme
